scientific_integrity: Universal results are derived analytically. A separate exact-rational verifier reproduces finite identities without serving as an exhaustive proof. Classical SPD turning-angle and subspace-embedding estimates are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact conditional guarantee for the ordinary sketched FOM of real SPD operators. No claim about random sketch success probabilities, numerical floating-point effects, indefinite/nonsymmetric matrices, harmonic Ritz values, iteration complexity, or an optimal bound on error. Priority outside the inspected literature is not independently certified.
title: Sharp positivity threshold for sketched FOM on SPD Krylov spaces
